source_snapshot.procedure: Connect the USB tool, boot the OS, install SST, clear BMC SEL, and stress USB for 12 hours.
source_snapshot.criteria: SST log and BMC SEL contain no errors.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; the physical 0C/+5% margin environment and supervised 12-hour run are not agent-runnable.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/IMPROVED; adds connector mapping, SuperSpeed proof, condensation control, preserved baseline, safe warm-up and restoration.

old_problem: Pending inputs were the physical USB3 path, SST profile, environmental tolerances and acceptance limits, although the purpose and safe method were already identifiable.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits binding the connector/tool/profile at runtime, ED-09 keeps physical connector and chamber work manual, ED-14 preserves the full 12-hour duration, ED-15 requires signed link/integrity limits, and ED-17 preserves rather than clears the pre-test evidence.
decision_basis: Directly read Stability row35 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek, GPT/history3073, and row36/history3074.
The exact front USB3 slot1 path must be mapped through cable, tool, hub/controller and proven to negotiate SuperSpeed before and throughout the run.
A timestamped baseline and deltas replace destructive log clearing; SST success alone cannot hide reset/re-enumeration or USB2 fallback.
0C work requires humidity/dew-point control, calibrated +5% rail evidence, abort limits, dry warm-up and nominal restoration.
Next row36 identity and variant were directly verified; no DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Front USB3 slot1 12-hour stress at 0C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails
test_case.purpose: Verify the mapped front USB3 slot1 sustains its approved 12-hour data-integrity stress at cold/high-rail margin without USB link fallback, data error, controller reset or platform event.
required_package: Pinned SST build and USB3 integrity profile
SuperSpeed, integrity, retry/reset and throughput limits
Abort, dry warm-up and nominal-restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: A qualified operator establishes the approved dry 0C soak and measured +5% rails, verifies the mapped slot1 tool remains at SuperSpeed, runs the pinned SST USB3 integrity profile for 12 hours while preserving link/error/environment telemetry, then warms above dew point, restores nominal rails and verifies post-health.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped connector completes the full 12 hours at the signed cold/high-rail condition with continuous required USB3 speed, no data mismatch or disallowed retry/reset/controller/kernel/SEL event, followed by safe restoration and healthy enumeration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the exact slot1 path, full 12-hour record, continuous SuperSpeed/integrity evidence and signed event limits. USB2 fallback, another port, shortened time, erased logs, moisture risk or unapproved limits cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified physical/chamber/high-rail operator and approved profile
Timestamp and preserve existing logs; do not clear evidence
Abort for condensation risk, electrical/thermal fault, reset storm or data mismatch
No automatic retry; warm above dew point before chamber opening or cable work
expected_evidence: SST version/profile and pre-test USB descriptor/SuperSpeed state
Twelve-hour integrity, link-speed, retry/reset and throughput log
Kernel/USB-controller/SEL deltas plus dry warm-up, restoration and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop safely on an abort, preserve all evidence, return rails to nominal, warm/dry above dew point before access, restore the qualified topology and do not automatically retry.

source_conflict.reason: Items, procedure and criteria consistently identify the front USB3 slot1 cold/high-rail stress; missing runtime limits are project bindings rather than conflicting requirements.

blocked.reason: Purpose, method and recovery are clear; execution remains qualified manual work.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind the slot1 physical path, SST build/profile, environmental/rail tolerances, USB3 integrity/link/event limits and restoration sign-off.

pending.unlock_condition: Approve and sign the parameter set before execution; this is a runtime safety gate, not an unresolved review decision.
